 Jets cop another blow in Asian Champions Leage campaign 
 October 27, 2026
 Montanna Clare 7 hours ago 17 
 Facebook 
 X 
 The Jets Asian Champions League campaign took another blow in Japan last night…as they let an early two goal lead slip.
 Newcastle was punished by Kyoto Sanga in the second half with a former Central Coast Mariner at the helm of the hosts resurgence.
